exercises.instructionEn: Read the Internet advertisements for pen-friends and answer the questions. Then, explain the words in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Pen-friend (xat orqali do'st) uchun internet e'lonlarini o'qing va savollarga javob bering. So'ng qalin yozilgan so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
E'lon qolipi — har uchalasi bir xil tartibda:
1) Ism va yosh: My name's X and I'm ... years old.
2) Joy: I live in SHAHAR, MAMLAKAT.
3) Tashqi ko'rinish: I have got + SOCH + eyes. I'm + bo'y/gavda.
4) Qiziqish: I like / I love + -ing.
5) Qobiliyat: I can + FE'L.
6) Chaqiriq: Please e-mail me / Hope to hear from you soon.

Shu qolip bo'yicha o'zingiz ham e'lon yoza olasiz.

⚠⚠ KITOB XATOSI (terish) — 2-E'LON:

  Kitobda: 'Please be my E--MAIL pen pal'

  ⚠ 'e' bilan 'mail' orasida IKKITA tire
  bosilgan. To'g'risi BITTA: 'e-mail'.

  ⚠ Xuddi shu jumlada 'I'm  quite short' —
  ikkita bo'sh joy qolgan.

  ⚠ Solishtiring: 1-e'londa (Pierre) shu
  so'z TO'G'RI — 'e-mail me today'.


⚠ BRITANChA / AMERIKAChA:

  Mashq sarlavhasida: 'PEN-FRIENDS'
     — Britaniya varianti
  Annaning e'lonida: 'PEN PAL'
     — Amerika varianti

  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham 'xat orqali do'st'
  degani. Bu Britaniya kursi bo'lgani
  uchun izchillik 'pen-friend' bo'lishi
  kerak edi.

rule.explanationUz:
'have got' — 'bor' ma'nosini beradi.
O'zbekchada 'Menda mushuk bor' deymiz — inglizchada 'I've got a cat'.

EGAGA qarab ikki shakl:
• I / you / we / they → HAVE got
• he / she / it       → HAS got

QAVS ICHIDAGI 'got' nima uchun? Chunki 'got' siz ham bo'ladi:
  'I have a cat' = 'I have got a cat' — ma'no bir xil.

rules.enRule: We use the verb have got to express possession.
We also use have got to describe people, animals or things.
rules.uzRule: Odam, hayvon va narsalarni TASVIRLASH uchun ham ishlatiladi.

rule.noteUz:
MUHIM: qisqa javobda 'got' TAKRORLANMAYDI.
  'Have you got a cat?' → 'Yes, I have.' ('Yes, I have got' XATO)
rule.warningUz:
DIQQAT — 'he's' ikki ma'noli:
  'he's got' = he HAS got  (egalik)
  'he's tall' = he IS tall  (holat)
'got' bo'lsa — HAS, bo'lmasa — IS.

rule.explanationUz: So'roqqa qisqa javob berishda ASOSIY FE'L takrorlanmaydi — faqat have/has qoladi.

keyRules.enRule: In short answers we do not use got.
keyRules.correct: Have you got a cat? — Yes, I have.
keyRules.whyUz: Qisqa javobda faqat yordamchi fe'l qoladi. Bu 'to be' dagi qoida bilan bir xil: 'Yes, he is' ('Yes, he is tall' emas).

rule.explanationUz:
'can' — modal fe'l. Uning eng katta afzalligi: BARCHA SHAXSDA BIR XIL.

O'zgarmaydi:
  I can walk · he can walk · they can walk
  'he cans' — XATO. -S QO'SHILMAYDI.

O'zidan keyingi fe'l ham o'zgarmaydi:
  'He can walk' — 'walks' ham, 'to walk' ham EMAS.

rules.enRule: We use can to show ability.
We also use can to express polite requests.
examples: Can you close the window, please?

interrogative.q: Can I/you/he, etc ... play the piano?

rule.interrogativeNoteUz: Qisqa javobda asosiy fe'l takrorlanmaydi: 'Yes, I can.' ('Yes, I can play' emas).
rule.exampleEn: I can sing well. He can sing well. They can sing well.
rule.exampleUz: Men yaxshi kuylay olaman. U yaxshi kuylay oladi. Ular yaxshi kuylay oladi.
rule.noteUz: Uchala gapda ham 'can' o'zgarmadi — mana shu 'can' ning qulayligi.
rule.warningUz:
To'liq inkor shakli — 'cannot', BITTA so'z.
  'can not' — deyarli ishlatilmaydi
  'cannot'  — to'g'ri
  'can't'   — qisqa, og'zaki

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the table with information about yourself, then write an Internet advertisement for a pen-friend. Use the texts in Ex. 4 as a model. Start with: Hello!/Hi!... Finish with: Please e-mail me today./Please, be my e-mail pen pal/Hope to hear from you soon.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalni o'zingiz haqingizdagi ma'lumot bilan to'ldiring, so'ng pen-friend uchun internet e'lonini yozing. Ex. 4 dagi matnlarni namuna qiling. Boshlanishi: Hello!/Hi!... Oxiri: Please e-mail me today. / Please, be my e-mail pen pal / Hope to hear from you soon.
exercises.explanationUz:
Unit 2 ning YAKUNIY ishi — jadvaldagi 9 qator 6 ta gapga aylanadi:

  1) Hi! My name's X and I'm ... years old.   (Name + Age)
  2) I live in SHAHAR, MAMLAKAT.              (Live in)
  3) I have got SOCH hair and RANG eyes.      (Hair + Eyes)
  4) I'm BO'Y and GAVDA.                      (Height + Build)
  5) I like/love + FE'L-ing.                  (Like)
  6) I can + FE'L + daraja.                   (Can)
  7) CHAQIRIQ jumlasi.

Har gap Unit 2 da o'rgangan bitta grammatikani ishlatadi.

tasks.en: Hi! My name's Aziz and I'm fifteen years old. I live in Tashkent, Uzbekistan. I have got short straight dark hair and brown eyes. I'm quite tall and slim. I like playing football and reading. I can speak Russian quite well. Please e-mail me today!
tasks.uz: Salom! Mening ismim Aziz va men o'n besh yoshdaman. Men Toshkentda, O'zbekistonda yashayman. Mening kalta tekis qora sochim va jigarrang ko'zim bor. Men ancha baland va nozikman. Men futbol o'ynash va o'qishni yoqtiraman. Men ruschani ancha yaxshi gapira olaman. Bugunoq menga e-xat yozing!

exercises.instructionEn: Write out the advertisement in full sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: E'lonni to'liq gaplar bilan yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
Berilgan so'zlardan to'liq gap tuzasiz. Har qismda kerakli so'zlarni
QO'SHISHINGIZ kerak:

  'My/name/be/Ingrid'  → 'My name IS Ingrid.'      (be → is)
  'I/live/Stockholm'   → 'I live IN Stockholm.'    ('in' qo'shildi)
  'I/have got/long fair hair/blue eyes'
                       → 'I have got long fair hair AND blue eyes.'
  'I/cook/very well'   → 'I CAN cook very well.'   ('can' qo'shildi)

DIQQAT: 'be' — bu fe'lning asos shakli. Egaga qarab am/is/are ga aylanadi.

tasks.en: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
tasks.uz: Boshingga ish tushganda yordam bergan — haqiqiy do'st.
tasks.note:
Ma'nosi: haqiqiy do'st sizga QIYIN paytda yordam beradi.
'in need' — muhtoj holatda · 'indeed' — haqiqatan.
DIQQAT: 'need' va 'indeed' qofiyalanadi — shuning uchun esda qoladi.
Unit nomi shu maqoldan olingan.

tasks.en: Lend your money and lose your friend.
tasks.note:
Ma'nosi: do'stga pul qarz berish do'stlikni buzishi mumkin.
'lend' — qarz BERMOQ · 'borrow' — qarz OLMOQ (ikkalasini adashtirmang!)
'lend' va 'lose' bir xil tovush bilan boshlanadi — bu ham esda saqlashga yordam beradi.

wordFormation.explanationUz: Ikki so'z birikib bitta sifat yasaydi. Chiziqcha SHART.
'like' va 'love' dan keyin fe'l -ing bilan keladi. Bu shakl mashg'ulot nomi ham bo'ladi.
E'lonlardagi shaharlar va mamlakatlar.
Ba'zi so'zlar -s olmaydi, o'zagi o'zgaradi. Yodlab olish shart.
Yuz qismlarining ko'pchiligi oddiy -s oladi.
Tashqi ko'rinish sifatlarini JUFT holda yodlang — ikki barobar tez esda qoladi.

Sifatga -ish qo'shilsa, ma'no YUMSHAYDI: to'liq emas, shunga o'xshash.
Bu juda foydali qo'shimcha — istalgan rangga qo'shsa bo'ladi.
Tomon nomiga -ern qo'shilib sifat yasaladi.
Matnlarda uchragan mamlakatlar.

Sifat NARSANI ta'riflaydi, ravish esa HARAKATNI.
Ko'pchilik ravish -ly bilan yasaladi.

wordFormation.ruleUz: QOIDASIZ ravishlar — bu betda aynan shular
wordFormation.explanationUz: Ikkita eng muhim ravish -ly OLMAYDI. Ular shakli o'zgarmaydi yoki butunlay boshqa so'z bo'ladi.
Ex. 13 dagi rasmlardagi odamlarning nomi.
Familiya oldidan qo'yiladi. NUQTA Britan inglizchasida qo'yilmaydi (Mr Harris).
Harflab aytishda bir xil harf ketma-ket kelsa 'double' deyiladi. Bu tezroq va tabiiyroq.

wordFormation.explanationUz: Bir xil ma'no, har xil muloyimlik. Rasmiy vaziyatda o'ngdagisini ishlating.

items.derived: Can you give me this, please?

wordFormation.explanationUz: Kundalik nutqda uzun shakllar qisqaradi.

Faqat bitta tovush farq qiladi, lekin so'z butunlay boshqa ma'noni beradi.
Bu juftlarni ATAYLAB mashq qilish kerak.
Talaffuz mashqidagi so'zlar shu qoida bilan yasalgan.
Apostrof tushib qolgan harflar o'rniga qo'yiladi.
Boshqa fe'llardan farqli, 'can not' emas, 'cannot' bitta so'z bo'lib yoziladi. Qisqasi esa oddiy: can't.
Bir xil yoziladi, lekin ikki xil fe'lni bildiradi. Farqni keyingi so'z aytadi.

wordFormation.ruleUz: Millat nomi KO'PLIKDA — butun xalq haqida
wordFormation.explanationUz: Millat nomiga -s qo'shilsa, o'sha xalqning vakillari tushuniladi va KO'PLIK fe'li kerak (have, are).
Bu betdagi buyum nomlari ikki so'zdan iborat. Ular BITTA narsa hisoblanadi, shuning uchun 'a' bitta qo'yiladi.
Bu betda oila a'zolari ko'p uchraydi — ular Unit 4 da chuqurroq o'rganiladi.
Bu betdagi 12 ta harakatning bajaruvchisi.

wordFormation.ruleUz: 'the' bor yoki yo'q — cholg'u va sport
wordFormation.explanationUz: ENG KO'P XATO QILINADIGAN QOIDA. Yodlab qo'ying:
O'zbekchada hammasi 'haydamoq' bo'ladi, inglizchada esa uch xil fe'l.

wordFormation.ruleUz: Kasb qo'shimchalari — artikl bilan birga yodlang
wordFormation.explanationUz: Kasbni yodlaganda artiklini ham birga yodlang — shunda xato qilmaysiz.
Ex.10 dagi savollar antonimlar ustiga qurilgan — savol bir tomonni, matn boshqasini aytadi.
Kontekstga qarab ma'nosi butunlay o'zgaradi. Matnda tez-tez chalkashtiriladi.
Tana qismlarining ba'zilari -s olmaydi. Ular eng ko'p ishlatiladigan so'zlar, shuning uchun yodlash shart.
Bu farqlar o'zbek o'quvchilari uchun eng ko'p xato manbai.
Rangning och yoki to'qligini bildirish uchun oldiga so'z qo'yiladi.
Ba'zi sifatlardan ot yasaladi. Yozilishi o'zgaradi — bu betda aynan shu xato qilingan.
Bir narsani turlicha ayta olish — nutqni boyitadi.
'you' va 'your' ni adashtirmang — biri EGA, ikkinchisi EGALIK.
Ex.9 dagi 'hairdresser' shu qoida bilan yasalgan.
Bu betdagi buyum va joy nomlari.
Harfning nomi bilan u beradigan tovush boshqa-boshqa. Imlo aytishda NOM ishlatiladi.
Mamlakat ko'pincha undosh yoki -o bilan tugaydi.
Mamlakat ko'pincha -a yoki -y bilan tugaydi. Bu eng katta guruh.
Ko'pincha Yevropa mamlakatlari.
Ko'pincha Osiyo mamlakatlari va Portugaliya. Bu shakl BIRLIK va KO'PLIKDA bir xil: 'a Japanese', 'two Japanese'.
Bu uchtasi hech qanday qoidaga bo'ysunmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + have/has got + SOCH TA'RIFI + hair
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I have got short straight dark hair.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mening kalta, tekis, qora sochim bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Tartib QAT'IY: uzunlik → shakl → rang → hair.
'long straight fair hair' to'g'ri; 'fair long straight hair' XATO.
I/you/we/they → have got · he/she/it → HAS got.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + have/has got + RANG + eyes
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I have got brown eyes.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mening ko'zim jigarrang.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'eyes' doim KO'PLIK (ikkita ko'z). 'I have got a brown eye' — noto'g'ri.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + be + BO'Y/GAVDA sifati
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm quite tall and slim. / Mario is tall and well-built.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men ancha baland va nozikman. / Mario baland va baquvvat.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Bo'y va gavda uchun 'be' ishlatiladi, 'have got' emas.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + can + FE'L (asos shakli)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I can play tennis very well. / She can play the piano.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men tennisni juda yaxshi o'ynay olaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'can' dan keyin fe'l O'ZGARMAYDI: 'he can play' (plays emas), 'to' ham qo'yilmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + like/love + FE'L-ing
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I love playing computer games. / I like reading.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men kompyuter o'yinlarini o'ynashni yaxshi ko'raman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'like/love' dan keyin fe'l -ING oladi. 'I like read' — XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + have/has got + NARSA
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I've got a dog. / My dog has got long ears.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menda it bor. / Itimning quloqlari uzun.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
I/you/we/they → have got · he/she/it → has got.
O'zbekchadagi 'menda ... bor' shu qolipga to'g'ri keladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: SO'ROQ: Have/Has + EGA + got ...?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Has Pierre got a beard? — No, he hasn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Pierrening soqoli bormi? — Yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Fe'l birinchi o'rinda. Qisqa javobda 'got' TAKRORLANMAYDI: 'No, he hasn't' ('hasn't got' emas).

sentencePatterns.formula: TA'RIF (3 gap): EGA + be + bo'y/gavda. EGA + have got + soch/ko'z. EGA + can + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He is quite tall and slim. He has got short dark hair and brown eyes. He can play tennis very well.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U ancha baland va nozik. Uning kalta qora sochi va jigarrang ko'zi bor. U tennisni juda yaxshi o'ynay oladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Odamni ta'riflashning to'liq qolipi. Bo'y/gavda uchun BE, soch/ko'z uchun HAVE GOT, qobiliyat uchun CAN.

sentencePatterns.formula: 3-SHAXS: He/She + FE'L-s
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He lives in Paris. He likes reading.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U Parijda yashaydi. U o'qishni yoqtiradi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: he/she/it bilan fe'lga -S qo'shiladi. LEKIN 'can' dan keyin qo'shilmaydi: 'He can play' (plays emas).

sentencePatterns.formula: Most people in JOY + are/have got + ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Most people in Mediterranean countries are rather short.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'rta yer dengizi mamlakatlarida ko'pchilik ancha past bo'yli.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'Most people' — ko'pchilik. Qat'iy 'all' o'rniga ishlatiladi, chunki hamma bir xil emas.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + are/have USUALLY got + ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They have usually got dark hair.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ularning odatda qora sochi bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'usually' HAVE va GOT orasiga tushadi: 'have usually got'. Bu tez-tez uchraydigan holatni bildiradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: What do people from JOY look like?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What do people from northern China look like?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shimoliy Xitoy aholisi qanday ko'rinishda?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'look like' — tashqi ko'rinishni so'rash. 'How do they look?' ham mumkin, lekin 'What ... look like?' odatiyroq.
DIQQAT: bu yerda 'do' ishlatiladi, chunki 'look' oddiy fe'l ('be' emas).

sentencePatterns.formula: They have ALSO got + ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They have also got dark brown eyes and full lips.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shuningdek to'q jigarrang ko'zi va to'la labi bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'also' — shuningdek. U HAVE va GOT orasiga tushadi. Qo'shimcha ma'lumot berishda ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + can + FE'L (asos shakli)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Tom can play football. / They can swim.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tom futbol o'ynay oladi. / Ular suza oladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'can' barcha shaxsda bir xil — -S yo'q, 'to' yo'q.
'He can plays' va 'He can to play' — ikkalasi ham XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: INKOR: EGA + can't + FE'L
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I can't hear a motorbike.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men mototsiklni eshitmayapman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: To'liq shakli 'cannot' — BITTA so'z bo'lib yoziladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: SO'ROQ: Can + EGA + FE'L? → Yes, EGA can. / No, EGA can't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can you cook? — Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ovqat pishira olasizmi? — Ha. / Yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'do/does' ishlatilmaydi. Qisqa javobda asosiy fe'l takrorlanmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: DARAJA: EGA + can + FE'L + very/quite + well/fast
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I can cook quite well. / She can swim very fast.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men ancha yaxshi ovqat pishiraman. / U juda tez suzadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Daraja so'zi fe'ldan KEYIN keladi. 'well' sifat uchun, 'fast' tezlik uchun.

sentencePatterns.formula: QARAMA-QARSHILIK: ... , but ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I can hear a cat, but I can't hear a motorbike.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men mushukni eshityapman, lekin mototsiklni eshitmayapman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'but' oldidan vergul qo'yiladi. Ikki qarama-qarshi gapni birlashtiradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: ILTIMOS: Can you + FE'L + , please?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can you help me, please?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menga yordam bera olasizmi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Bu yerda 'can' qobiliyat emas — muloyim ILTIMOS. 'please' oxirida, vergul bilan.

sentencePatterns.formula: ILTIMOS: Can you + FE'L + ... , please?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can you read this for me, please?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Buni menga o'qib bera olasizmi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'please' oxirida, vergul bilan. Buyruq gapdan ('Read this') ancha muloyim.

sentencePatterns.formula: QOBILIYAT: EGA + can + FE'L + daraja
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Ann can use the computer very well.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ann kompyuterdan juda yaxshi foydalana oladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: So'roq emas, 'please' yo'q — demak bu qobiliyat, iltimos emas.

sentencePatterns.formula: IMLO: How do you spell it? → HARF - HARF - double HARF ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How do you spell it? — A - double N - A ... H - U - G - H - E - S.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Buni qanday yozasiz? — A - ikkita N - A ...
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ism va familiya orasida qisqa pauza. Ikkilangan harf uchun 'double'.

sentencePatterns.formula: RO'YXAT: What's your name/address? · How old are you? · What's your phone number?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What's your home address? — 7, Green Street.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uy manzilingiz qanday? — Green ko'chasi, 7-uy.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Manzil ingliz tilida TESKARI tartibda: uy raqami → ko'cha → shahar.
O'zbekchada 'Green ko'chasi, 7-uy', inglizchada '7, Green Street'.

sentencePatterns.formula: XIZMAT: Can I help you? → Yes please. I'd like to ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can I help you? — Yes please. I'd like to join the tennis club.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yordam bera olamanmi? — Ha, iltimos. Tennis klubiga a'zo bo'lmoqchiman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Do'kon, klub, bankda eng ko'p eshitiladigan savol. Javobda 'I'd like to' — muloyim shakl.

sentencePatterns.formula: SALOM: SALOMLASHISH + How are you? → JAVOB + And you?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Good morning, Paul. How are you? — Very well, thanks. And you?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Xayrli tong, Paul. Qalaysiz? — Juda yaxshi, rahmat. Siz-chi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Javob bergach savolni QAYTARISH shart — aks holda qo'pol eshitiladi.
Qaytarish uchun: 'And you?' yoki 'How are you?'

sentencePatterns.formula: XAYR: Goodbye/Bye + tilak → You too.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Goodbye. Have a nice evening. — You too. Goodbye.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Xayr. Kechangiz xayrli o'tsin. — Sizga ham. Xayr.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'You too' — tilakni qaytarish. Juda tez-tez ishlatiladi.
Uzun javob shart emas: 'You too' o'zi yetarli.

sentencePatterns.formula: E'LON: Hi! My name's X and I'm ... → ... → CHAQIRIQ
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Hi! My name's Aziz and I'm fifteen years old. ... Please e-mail me today!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Salom! Mening ismim Aziz va men o'n besh yoshdaman. ... Bugunoq menga e-xat yozing!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
E'lon HAR DOIM chaqiriq bilan tugaydi — aks holda o'quvchi javob bermaydi.
Uchta tayyor variant bor (Please e-mail me / be my pen pal / Hope to hear).

sentencePatterns.formula: TASVIR: NARSA/ODAM + with + XUSUSIYAT
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The man with a beard is my teacher.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Soqolli erkak — mening o'qituvchim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'with' — 'who has got' ning qisqa varianti. Gapni ixchamlashtiradi:
  'the man who has got a beard' → 'the man with a beard'

sentencePatterns.formula: EGALIK: EGA + have/has got + NARSA
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I've got a cat. / She's got a red bicycle.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Menda mushuk bor. / Unda qizil velosiped bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: I/you/we/they → have got · he/she/it → has got.

sentencePatterns.formula: TAVSIF: EGA + have/has got + XUSUSIYAT
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She's got green eyes.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uning ko'zi yashil.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Soch, ko'z, burun kabi tug'ma xususiyatlar uchun ham 'have got' ishlatiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: SO'ROQ: Have/Has + EGA + got ...? → Yes, EGA have/has.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Has he got blue eyes? — Yes, he has. / No, he hasn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uning ko'zi ko'kmi? — Ha. / Yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Qisqa javobda 'got' YO'Q. 'do/does' ham ishlatilmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: QOBILIYAT: EGA + can + FE'L
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I can sing well. He can sing well. They can sing well.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men/u/ular yaxshi kuylay oladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'can' hech qachon o'zgarmaydi va o'zidan keyingi fe'lni ham o'zgartirmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: ILTIMOS: Can you + FE'L ... , please?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can you close the window, please?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Derazani yopa olasizmi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Bir xil 'can', lekin bu yerda qobiliyat emas — iltimos. Vaziyat farqni ko'rsatadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: TASDIQ: EGA + has/have got + NARSA
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: My grandfather has got grey hair.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bobomning sochi kulrang.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Bitta odam → has, ko'plik → have. Millat nomlari (Asians, Jamaicans) — KO'PLIK.

sentencePatterns.formula: QARAMA-QARSHILIK: EGA + hasn't got X, BUT EGA + has got Y
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Michael hasn't got a car, but he has got a stereo.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Michaelda mashina yo'q, lekin stereo bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'but' ikki qarama-qarshi holatni bog'laydi: biri inkor, ikkinchisi tasdiq.

sentencePatterns.formula: SAVOL–JAVOB–TUZATISH (3 qism)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Has she got dark hair? — No, she hasn't. She's got fair hair.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uning sochi qorami? — Yo'q. Uning sochi oq-sariq.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Inkor javobdan keyin TO'G'RISINI aytish — tabiiy muloqot qoidasi.
Faqat 'No, she hasn't' deyish kam, chunki suhbatdosh to'g'ri javobni bilmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: ARTIKL: a + BIRLIK ot · artiklsiz + KO'PLIK/soch
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Has he got a guitar? / Have they got books? / Has she got dark hair?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uning gitarasi bormi? / Ularda kitob bormi? / Uning sochi qorami?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Sanaladigan birlik ot → a/an.
Ko'plik (books) va sanalmaydigan (hair) → artikl YO'Q.

sentencePatterns.formula: What can + EGA + do? → EGA + can + FE'L
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What can he do? — He can ride a bicycle.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U nima qila oladi? — U velosiped hayday oladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ochiq savol — 'nima qila oladi?' Javobda aniq harakat aytiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Can + EGA + FE'L? → Yes, EGA can. / No, EGA can't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can Jack dance? — No, he can't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jack raqsga tusha oladimi? — Yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Yopiq savol — ha/yo'q javobi. Qisqa javobda fe'l takrorlanmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + can X, but EGA + can't Y
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Karen can dance, but she can't play football.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Karen raqsga tusha oladi, lekin futbol o'ynay olmaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'but' ikki qarama-qarshi qobiliyatni bog'laydi. Vergul 'but' dan OLDIN.

sentencePatterns.formula: KO'PLIK: EGA(ko'plik) + can + FE'L
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Jack and Chris can play football, but they can't dance.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jack va Chris futbol o'ynay oladi, lekin raqsga tusha olmaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Ega ko'plik bo'lsa ham 'can' O'ZGARMAYDI — bu uning eng katta qulayligi.

sentencePatterns.formula: KENGAYTIRILGAN JAVOB: Yes, I can. + qo'shimcha ma'lumot
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can you swim? — Yes, I can. I can swim quite well.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Suza olasizmi? — Ha. Ancha yaxshi suzaman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Faqat 'Yes, I can' quruq eshitiladi. Qo'shimcha ma'lumot suhbatni davom ettiradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: BE bilan: Is/Are + EGA + ...? → Yes, EGA is/are. / No, EGA isn't/aren't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is he English? — No, he isn't. He's American.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U inglizmi? — Yo'q. U amerikalik.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Holat, millat, kasb, yosh, bo'y-gavda uchun.

sentencePatterns.formula: HAVE GOT bilan: Has/Have + EGA + got ...? → Yes, EGA has/have.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Has he got short hair? — Yes, he has.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uning sochi kaltami? — Ha.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Egalik va tug'ma xususiyat uchun. Qisqa javobda 'got' YO'Q.

sentencePatterns.formula: CAN bilan: Can + EGA + FE'L? → Yes, EGA can. / No, EGA can't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can he ski? — Yes, he can.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U chang'i ucha oladimi? — Ha.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Qobiliyat uchun. Fe'l asos shaklida, -S yo'q.

sentencePatterns.formula: SAVOL SO'ZI: Who (odam) · What (narsa) · Where (joy) · How old (yosh)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Who is she? / What is it? / Where are they? / How old are you?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U kim? / Bu nima? / Ular qayerda? / Necha yoshdasiz?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Odam uchun WHO, narsa uchun WHAT. Ikkalasidan keyin ham fe'l egadan OLDIN keladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: XATO TOPISH: fe'l egaga mos keladimi?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The Pyramids IS in Cairo → The Pyramids ARE in Cairo.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Har gapda tekshiring: ega birlikmi yoki ko'plikmi?
Ko'plik belgilari: -s (Pyramids, neighbours), 'and' bilan bog'langan ismlar (Mario and Peter).

sentencePatterns.formula: NARSA + is + RANG
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: A lemon is yellow. / A penguin is black and white.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Limon sariq. / Pingvin qora va oq.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Rang aytishda 'be' ishlatiladi. Ikki rang bo'lsa 'and' bilan bog'lanadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: What COLOUR + NARSA + has + EGA + got?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What colour eyes has Eric got? — He's got dark brown eyes.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ericning ko'zi qanday rangda? — Uning to'q jigarrang ko'zi bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: RANG so'ralganda 'What colour'. So'roqda 'has Eric got' tartibi.

sentencePatterns.formula: What SORT of + NARSA + has + EGA + got?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What sort of hair has he got? — He's got light brown straight hair.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uning sochi qanday? — Uning och jigarrang tekis sochi bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
TUR yoki TAVSIF so'ralganda 'What sort of' (yoki 'What kind of').
Javobda uzunlik, shakl va rang birga aytiladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA + has got + KO'Z + and + SOCH
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Ann has got blue eyes and short grey curly hair.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Annning ko'k ko'zi va kalta kulrang jingalak sochi bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Ikki xususiyat bitta gapda 'and' bilan birlashtiriladi — bu tabiiyroq,
ikkita alohida gapdan ko'ra.

sentencePatterns.formula: TO'LIQ TAVSIF (5 gap): yosh → bo'y/gavda → soch → yuz → boshqa
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Ian is fifty-two years old. He is middle-aged. He is of medium height and he is fat. He has got grey straight hair, a beard and a moustache. He has got a large nose and full lips.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ian ellik ikki yoshda. U o'rta yoshli. U o'rta bo'yli va semiz. Uning kulrang tekis sochi, soqoli va mo'ylovi bor. Katta burni va to'la labi bor.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Tartib buzilmasin. Bo'y-gavda uchun BE, soch-yuz uchun HAVE GOT.

sentencePatterns.formula: 'of medium height' — o'rta bo'y
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He is of medium height.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U o'rta bo'yli.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Bu ibora 'of' bilan keladi — 'He is medium height' ham eshitiladi, lekin 'of' bilan to'g'riroq.

sentencePatterns.formula: SO'ROQ: Is/Are + EGA + ...? (fe'l BIRINCHI)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is your car new? / Is he from Portugal?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mashinangiz yangimi? / U Portugaliyadanmi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ENG KO'P XATO shu yerda. Tasdiq gapda 'Your car is new', so'roqda esa 'IS your car new?' — fe'l oldinga chiqadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: JAVOB: No, EGA + be + from + MAMLAKAT.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: No, he's from Turkey.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yo'q, u Turkiyadan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'from' TUSHIB QOLMASIN. Va odam haqida bo'lsa 'he/she', narsa haqida bo'lsa 'it'.

sentencePatterns.formula: INKORDA 'or': EGA + hasn't/haven't got + A + or + B
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They haven't got a camera or a computer.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ularda kamera ham, kompyuter ham yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
INKOR gapda 'and' emas, 'OR' ishlatiladi.
  'haven't got a camera OR a computer' — TO'G'RI
  'haven't got a camera AND a computer' — noto'g'ri
Tasdiq gapda esa 'and': 'has got a camera AND a TV'.

sentencePatterns.formula: BE yoki HAVE GOT — qaysi biri?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Are they tall? (bo'y) / Has he got fair hair? (soch)
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular baland bo'ylimi? / Uning sochi oq-sariqmi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
BE — odamning O'ZI qanaqa (bo'y, gavda, yosh, millat, kasb).
HAVE GOT — odamda NIMA BOR (soch, ko'z, burun, narsalar).

sentencePatterns.formula: EGA MAJBURIY: No, THEY'RE quite short.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Are they tall? — No, they're quite short.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular baland bo'ylimi? — Yo'q, ular ancha past.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
O'zbekchada 'Yo'q, past' desa bo'ladi. Inglizchada EGA tushib qolmaydi:
'No, THEY'RE quite short.'

sentencePatterns.formula: SAVOLDAGI EGA javobdagi egani belgilaydi
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Where are you from? → I'm ... · Where are you and your friend from? → We're ...
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qayerdansiz? → Men... · Siz va do'stingiz qayerdansiz? → Biz...
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Savolda 'you' bitta odamga qaratilgan bo'lsa 'I', ikki kishiga bo'lsa 'we'.

sentencePatterns.formula: What's your FIRST NAME / LAST NAME / ADDRESS / PHONE NUMBER?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What's your last name? — Baker.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Familiyangiz nima? — Baker.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Inglizchada ism OLDIN, familiya KEYIN — o'zbekchadan teskari.
first name = ism · last name / surname = familiya

sentencePatterns.formula: MANZIL: UY RAQAMI, KO'CHA NOMI
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: 27, Apple Street.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Apple ko'chasi, 27-uy.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Uy raqami BIRINCHI, ko'cha keyin — o'zbekchadan teskari tartib.

sentencePatterns.formula: RASMIY vs NORASMIY salomlashish
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Good afternoon, Mrs Brown. How are you? / Hi Bob, how are you?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Xayrli kun, Brown xonim. Qalaysiz? / Salom Bob, qalaysan?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Rasmiyda: Good morning/afternoon + Mr/Mrs + familiya, javobda 'thank you'.
Norasmiyda: Hi/Hello + ism, javobda 'thanks'.

sentencePatterns.formula: E'LON: Hi. My name is X. I am ... I live in ... I have got ... I can ... Be my pen-friend.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Hi. My name is Ingrid Jönsson. I am sixteen years old. I live in Stockholm, Sweden. I have got long fair hair and blue eyes. I am tall and slim. I like skiing and I love swimming. I can cook very well. Be my pen-friend.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Salom. Mening ismim Ingrid Jönsson. Men o'n olti yoshdaman. Men Stokgolmda, Shvetsiyada yashayman. Mening uzun oq-sariq sochim va ko'k ko'zim bor. Men baland va nozikman. Chang'i uchishni yoqtiraman va suzishni yaxshi ko'raman. Juda yaxshi ovqat pishira olaman. Mening xat-do'stim bo'ling.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Unit 2 ning YAKUNIY qolipi — 9 ta gap. Har biri o'rgangan bitta grammatikani ishlatadi:
be · live in · have got · like/love + -ing · can · buyruq gap.

sentencePatterns.formula: MASHG'ULOT nomidan oldin 'the' YO'Q
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I like skiing. / I love swimming.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Chang'i uchishni yoqtiraman. / Suzishni yaxshi ko'raman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'I like THE skiing' — XATO. Mashg'ulot nomi (-ing shakli) artiklsiz keladi.
